comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A Memorial Album consisting of seven items which must be created by modifying base items with transmutation alchemy and "Sophia" points. In order to unlock the recipes, you must first make a specific discovery on the Legacy Theme; IE, the Top/12:00 position unlocks the second recipe on this list.

Items are as follow:

01. Musician's Gloves (Upper Right, 2:00)
Skills: Alchemy r11/Sewing r11
Base Item: Gloves
Ingredients: Element of Wisdomx5　Embroidery Threadx20　Ignis Solutionx10
Sophia: 1,500

02. Harp of the Saint King (Top, 12:00)
Skills: Alchemy r11/Handicrafts r11
Base Item: Old Testament
Ingredients: Element of Wisdomx5　Ebonyx20　Ignis Solutionx10
Sophia: 1,500

03. Hero's Hornpipe (Lower Right, 4:00)
Skills: Alchemy r11/Handicrafts r11
Base Item: Tactician's Horn
Ingredients: Element of Wisdomx3　Ivoryx20　Aqua Concentratex10
Sophia: 1,300

04. Ancient Indian Sheet Music (Bottom, 6:00)
Skills: Alchemy r11/Handicrafts r11
Base Item: Poetry Anthology
Ingredients: Element of Wisdomx3　Indian Ocean Translation Notex20　﻿Ventus Reductionx10
Sophia: 1,300

05. Dolphin Anchor (Upper Left, 10:00)
Skills: Alchemy r11/Handicrafts r11
Base Item: Porpoise
Ingredients: Element of Wisdomx5　White Alchemy Ointmentx20　﻿Terra Extractx10
Sophia: 1,600

06. Bugle (Center, 0:00)
Skills: Alchemy r11/Casting r11
Base Item: Hunting Horn
Ingredients: Element of Wisdomx5　Red Alchemy Ointmentx20　﻿﻿Terra Extract﻿x10
Sophia: 1,600

07. Cursed Magic Horn (Lower Left, 8:00)
Skills: Alchemy r11/Handicrafts r11
Base Item: Unicorn Horn
Ingredients: Element of Wisdomx5　Medusa's Cursex20　Aqua Concentratex10
Sophia: 1,600

MA reward: Complete Works of Music
Obtained from: Duchess of Traetto
(Genoa)

Total Sophia required: 10,400
Total Element of Wisdom required: 31

When you have completed the MA and obtained its reward, a selection of special titles are permanently unlocked as well.

Source: wittyship.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1376.html
